title: Stress Fixture
subtitle: Cases the benchmark does not contain

heading.lead: A two-tone heading long enough that it has to wrap across more than one line
heading.accent: and the accent half wraps too, which is where balance breaks

blocks.text: If the heading treatment only works at benchmark length, this section shows it.
A labelled section with no heading at all.
A section with a heading but no eyebrow label.
Unclosed bold **starts here and never ends, which must render literally.
Unclosed code `starts here and never ends, also literal.
Nested **outer with `inner code` inside** and a stray ** after.
Raw HTML <script>alert(1)</script> and an ampersand & must be escaped.
Empty markers `` and **** stay as written.

blocks.text: The callout below is positioned so it lands near a page break. It must move whole, never split.

blocks.label: GOTCHA
blocks.subtitle: PAGE BREAKS
blocks.text: A callout that splits across a page loses its accent bar on the second half and reads as two unrelated panels. `break-inside: avoid` is what prevents it. If this panel is split, the rule is not being honoured.

sections.label: G. CODE TALLER THAN A PAGE

blocks.text: A code block that cannot fit on any page. `break-inside: avoid` cannot help here — it must degrade gracefully rather than vanish or overflow.

blocks.caption: Three layers — the minimum a stack can carry.
Nine layers, several carrying notes, tones cycling beyond the palette's six.
